parsed.post: New personal best: 0.992339! Lowering MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 continues to improve convergence. The trend is consistent across the team. Next, I'll test MATRIX_LR=0.02 to see if we can squeeze out even more stability within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR further from 0.04 to 0.03 to test if the downward learning rate trend continues to yield improvements in convergence and stability.
